coverage.why: Every accounting area and industry_lens carries a finding and verdict, every financial section plus dupont and path_to_distress carries a reading, and input_manifest.json analysis_stages record no drops for analysis_accounting or analysis_financial.

calibration.why: Verdicts track their anomalies: estimates_and_reserves and cost_deferral say 'Adverse lean' over the warranty, useful-life, derivative and capitalization items, and revenue_recognition says 'Watch, not yet adverse' over wording and receivable-day items; only the cash_flow_engineering verdict leaves out its Hapoalim and on-demand facility anomalies.

valuation_reading.why: calculator.json prints market.missing, implied_growth_beside_history.implied_ten_year_revenue_growth.missing and no sensitivity grid, so the reading can neither place the price nor state implied growth, and it calls its two sensitive assumptions 'a reading of the drivers, not a computed result'.
